jobs.description:
Amazon Security Lake is a fully managed security data lake service that automatically centralizes security data from AWS environments, SaaS providers, on-premises sources, and third-party products into a purpose-built data lake, normalizing it to the Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework (OCSF) so customers get a single, analytics-ready view of their security posture across their entire organization. Security Lake operates across AWS commercial and GovCloud Regions and is trusted by many of the world's largest enterprises with their most sensitive data.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to serve as a technical leader for Security Lake and across the broader AWS Security Services organization. This role is unusual in its breadth: beyond owning the architecture and operational excellence of a security-critical, customer-facing data service, you will lead critical-path initiatives across our portfolio — including Amazon Security Hub and Amazon Inspector services. You will regularly be the senior engineer who lands in an unfamiliar codebase, earns the trust of another team's engineers, and converts an ambiguous business problem into a shipped, production system. If you want the reach of a platform role combined with the hands-on depth of a service team, this is that job.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the design of major deliverables end-to-end — from working backwards on ambiguous requirements, through design documents and security reviews (threat models, AppSec, operational readiness), to implementation, launch, and production operation
- Serve as a technical leader across AWS Security Services: embed with partner teams (Amazon Inspector, AWS Security Hub, AWS Config), deliver on their critical path to their standards and release calendars, and hand over cleanly with documentation, tests, canaries, and runbooks
- Own and raise the operational bar for Security Lake: root-cause high-severity issues to resolution, harden APIs and canaries, drive down recurring alarms, and keep a security-critical service healthy and efficient
- Set technical direction and simplify: promote re-use and extension over new components, pay down architectural debt, and turn one-off solutions into durable practices the whole team adopts
- Drive decisions across team boundaries — when a dependency has no fix, propose the options, build consensus among stakeholders, and unblock the launch
- Mentor and grow engineers through thorough (but kind) code and design reviews, onboarding of new team members, and raising the performance bar with every review

A day in the life
Most of your time is spent doing hands-on engineering: designing, writing, and reviewing code for distributed data-processing and control-plane systems (primarily Java and Python services with TypeScript/CDK infrastructure). In a typical week you might author a design for a new cross-service security capability and drive it through review with senior engineers from two other teams, ship code into a partner team's codebase, dig into a production alarm and turn the root cause into a fix plus a runbook, and give design feedback that changes the direction of a teammate's approach. You will share the team's on-call rotation and own customer issues to resolution — customers trust this service with their security data, and operational excellence is everyone's job, with senior engineers setting the example. The team is compact, senior-leaning, and geographically distributed, which means high autonomy, direct access to Principal Engineers and leadership across AWS Security Services, and visible ownership of everything you ship.

Intel Corporation is one of the world's leading semiconductor companies, driving innovation across computing, connectivity, and artificial intelligence. Our Advanced Packaging ,Test and Manufacturing (APTM) organization is at the forefront of this transformation, delivering industry-leading packaging and test technologies that power products across Client, Data Center, AI, Networking, and External Foundry markets. We are seeking a talented and driven Sort Interface Pathfinding and Development Engineer to join our Sort Interface Development team in Oregon. In this high-impact role, you will pioneer breakthrough silicon interface probing & test solutions that enable best-in-class die and wafer sort capabilities across leading-edge process nodes and advanced heterogeneous packaging platforms — including EMIB, EMIB-T, Foveros, and Foveros Direct.

As Intel scales its Open System Foundry and OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) business model, you will play an instrumental role in establishing world-class, customer-ready sort interface capabilities. We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

*Open to hiring remote on the West Coast— preferable to have someone near our office in SF or Seattle.

We're looking for someone to join our IT team and take ownership of day-to-day technical support for a globally distributed company. You'd report to the Head of IT/Security and be the first point of contact for employees with requests, device issues, and account problems.

You'll own the fundamentals from day one: handling tickets, provisioning laptops, running on-boarding, and keeping our SaaS stack in order. But this is a small team at a fast-growing AI company, so the scope grows quickly. You'll get pulled into real projects sooner than you'd expect, across security, infrastructure, and automation. How far you take it depends on what you're good at and what interests you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Handle help-desk tickets: Triage and resolve employee requests — password resets, access provisioning, Slack/Google Workspace/Zoom troubleshooting, and general "my thing is broken" support

- Manage the device lifecycle: Procure, provision, configure, and ship laptops for new hires. Handle off-boarding wipes and returns. Keep the asset inventory accurate.

- Run on-boarding and off-boarding: Create accounts, apply security profiles, draft welcome communications, and make sure new employees have everything before day one

- Administer Google Workspace: Manage users, groups, aliases, and license assignments. You'll use both the admin console and CLI tools regularly.

- Support endpoint compliance: Work with our device trust tooling to keep employee machines meeting security policies, and follow up when they don't

- Deploy and enforce security policies: Help roll out and maintain endpoint security configurations, access controls, and compliance requirements across the fleet

- Manage corporate software: Handle seat assignments, renewals, license optimization, and access reviews across our SaaS stack

- Support office networking and AV: Help maintain networking equipment, conference room setups, and office technology across our physical locations as needed

- Train and enable employees: Deliver lightweight technical guidance and training on IT systems, both for new hires and for ongoing support (written guides, short walkthroughs, the occasional screen share)

- Write things down: Maintain run-books, knowledge base articles, and process docs. If you fix something, document how.

WHERE THIS ROLE CAN GROW

We don't expect you to stay in a pure helpdesk lane. Our SOC2 program has ongoing evidence collection and device trust work to pick up, and there's security policy work that needs someone to own the rollout and enforcement side.

On the infrastructure side, we manage cloud resources through infrastructure-as-code, and there's room to contribute once you're comfortable. We also automate a lot (scripting, CI/CD pipelines) and there's no shortage of manual process waiting to be turned into a workflow.

Over time, you'd lead IT projects around endpoint management, security improvements, and internal tooling rather than just executing on them.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Some form of IT support experience. A help-desk role, an internal support function, or just being the person everyone came to when something broke. The title matters less than the reps.

- Comfort with macOS. Our user endpoint fleet is mostly Mac. You should be able to troubleshoot system issues, manage profiles, and work in the terminal without hand-holding.

- Familiarity with Google Workspace administration, or the confidence to pick it up fast. CLI admin tooling experience is a plus.

- A working understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN basics, and how traffic moves. You don't need to be a network engineer, but you shouldn't be lost when a connectivity issue comes in.

- Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles. You should know what endpoint security, encryption, and access controls are, and why they matter, even if you haven't built policies from scratch.

- Strong written communication. This is a remote role and coordination happens in Slack and Notion. If you can't write clearly, the timezone gap makes everything harder.

- Self-direction. There's separation between you and the rest of the IT team for part of the day. You need to be someone who sees what needs doing and does it.

- Curiosity about how systems work. Maybe you've run a homelab, automated something tedious with a script, or set up a Pi. We care more about the impulse than the resume line.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with MDM platforms (any of the major ones)

- Any exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, etc) and infrastructure-as-code concepts

- Scripting in Python, Bash, or JavaScript

- Familiarity with zero-trust networking concepts and tools

- Background in compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001)

Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. About the role

We're hiring an Enterprise Platform Engineer to build the foundational systems that make Cursor ready for the world's largest engineering organizations.

Today we have basic organizations, simple IAM primitives, early audit logs, analytics APIs, and admin APIs — but enterprise customers need much more. You will design and build the platform layer that powers organization management, access control, compliance, and administrative tooling across Cursor's product surface. This is a deeply technical IC role focused on building correct, secure, and scalable enterprise infrastructure — not gluing together vendor SDKs.

What you’ll do

- Build and evolve our organization management system — multi-level org structures, groups, roles, lifecycle, and provisioning via SCIM, so admins can manage thousands of seats without friction.

- Design and implement RBAC with fine-grained roles, permissions, and resource scopes that cover organizations, teams, agents, and other resources — balancing security with developer ergonomics.

- Extend enterprise settings and policies — org-wide defaults, security policies (allowed models, MCPs, Tools, network restrictions), and configuration inheritance across different products.

- Deepen our audit logging infrastructure — comprehensive, queryable, tamper-evident audit trails that satisfy customer-specific compliance requirements.

- Build admin APIs and internal tooling that enterprise admins, customer success, and sales engineering depend on to manage organizations, investigate access issues, and onboard large accounts.

- Ship compliance features end-to-end — SSO enforcement, session management, allowlisting, data analytics, and the controls that procurement and security teams require before signing.

- Partner with product, security, and infrastructure teams to define enterprise platform abstractions that scale across the product without slowing down feature development.

- You will own organization management, RBAC and authorization, enterprise settings and policies, audit logs, admin APIs, and compliance-related platform features. You will be a technical authority on how Cursor models identity, access, and governance for enterprise customers.

- You will not own SSO/IdP integration at the protocol level (we use WorkOS) or billing and payments.

- Security and correctness are part of the job, but the goal is to build systems with enough rigor and observability that enterprise operations are boring — not to manually triage every access control edge case.

You may be a fit if

- You've built multi-tenant organization or IAM systems in production and have opinions on permission models, role inheritance, and policy evaluation.

- You've shipped RBAC or ABAC systems and understand the tradeoffs between flexibility and complexity.

- You deeply about correctness in authorization and understand why "fail closed" matters.

- You can hold the tension between "ship enterprise features fast" and "do not create security gaps or break existing access patterns."

- You feel comfortable shipping features end-to-end — from database schema and API design to admin UI and documentation.

jobs.description: Amazonは、何百万もの商品をお客様のもとへ届け続けることで、世界的に高い認知を得たグローバルリーディングカンパニーです。 その物流を最前線で支える物流拠点がフルフィルメントセンター（以下FC）であり、そのFCを「安全・快適・効率的」に保ち続けるのが、私たちRME-Facilities（施設管理）チームです。 快適な現場も、雰囲気の良いオフィスも、みんなが楽しみにするイベントも、あなたが整える施設の一つひとつが、Amazonで働く一人ひとりの毎日を支えています。 **あなたの仕事で、数千人の「働く」が変わる。** 施設管理の専門経験は問いません。 Amazonの施設に興味があり、働く人のために動くのが好きな方であれば大歓迎です。 建物・設備の知識は、先輩のサポートを受けながら現場で少しずつ身につけていけます。 本ポジションは、FCで働くすべての人を"カスタマー"と捉え、魅力的で働きやすい職場づくりを推進する役割になります。 主な業務 はじめは先輩と一緒に、慣れてきたら少しずつ任される範囲を広げていきます。 ■働く環境と人を支える仕事 オフィス環境の整備 — レイアウト変更や快適な職場づくりなど、従業員が気持ちよく働ける環境を整えます。 備品・消耗品の管理と購買・請求書処理 — 必要なものが不足しないよう手配し、日々の購買・請求書処理を進めます。 売店・Cafeteriaの運営管理 — 従業員満足度の向上に向けて、食堂運営会社と協力してサービスレベルの維持・改善に取り組みます。 従業員向けイベントの企画・運営 — FCで働く人が楽しめるイベントを自ら企画・運営します。自分が企画したイベントで従業員が笑顔になる瞬間に立ち会えることも、このポジションならではのやりがいです。 社内外の窓口・調整 — ベンダーや業者、行政などとの窓口を担い、必要な調整を進めます。 ■建物・設備を守る仕事 施設の維持管理 — 建築・電気・空調・衛生・消火・昇降設備といった建物全体のインフラについて、点検結果の確認や修繕の手配・発注を行い、倉庫の安定稼働を支えます。 省エネルギー活動 — エネルギー使用量のデータをもとに、照明のLED化や空調運転スケジュールの見直しなどを進め、環境負荷の低減とコスト削減の両立を目指します。 廃棄物・リサイクル管理 — FC内で発生する産業廃棄物やリサイクル品の回収・分別を、安全・品質・生産性の観点で管理・改善します。マニフェスト管理や行政報告など、法令に沿った手続きも担います。 **このポジションの魅力** 幅広い経験がキャリアの土台になる — 建物・設備・環境・総務・イベント企画まで、施設に関わることを幅広く経験できます。特定分野に偏らない経験は、この先どんなキャリアにも活きる強みになります。 若手でも「任される」 — 発注者側の立場で、業者やベンダーへの依頼・調整を自分で進めていきます。指示を待つのではなく、自分で考えて動ける環境です（最初は先輩がしっかりサポートします）。 カスタマーの声がダイレクトに届く — 「美味しい食事が食べられて快適に働ける」「オフィスの雰囲気が良くなった」といったポジティブな声を、すぐそばで直接受け取れます。 AI・生成AIを日常業務に — Amazonでは最新のAIツールや生成AIを日々の業務に取り入れています。学習を継続する文化が根付いており、ご自身のペースでAIや施設管理の知識を深められるリソースが用意されています。 **こんな方を歓迎します** - Profil recherché :

• Vous avez plus de 8 ans d'expérience dans un poste technique en contact avec la clientèle, par exemple en tant qu'ingénieur en déploiement avancé, ou en tant qu'ingénieur logiciel avec une expérience de conseil. Les anciens fondateurs techniques sont également encouragés à poser leur candidature.
• Vous avez de l'expérience en production avec des LLM, incluant l'ingénierie avancée des prompts, le développement d'agents, les cadres d'évaluation et le déploiement à grande échelle.
• Vous avez de solides compétences en programmation avec une maîtrise de Python (et idéalement d'un ou plusieurs autres langages comme TypeScript, Java, etc.) et une expérience de l'expédition d'applications de production.

Haute capacité d'action, capable de surmonter l'ambiguïté qui caractérise les organisations complexes.
• Esprit de coopération élevé pour la collaboration inter-organisationnelle, équilibrant les priorités concurrentes avec intégrité.
• Passion pour la promotion de systèmes d'IA sûrs et bénéfiques à travers des applications techniques créatives.
• Solides compétences en communication pour mener des discussions exploratoires avec les clients et transmettre des concepts techniques à divers intervenants tout en conservant une attitude humble et collaborative.
• Une expérience dans le domaine des services financiers, des soins de santé/sciences de la vie ou d'un autre secteur d'activité est un atout.
• Une expérience des systèmes informatiques d'entreprise et/ou des modèles de déploiement de l'IA est un atout.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As a member of the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who embeds directly with our most strategic customers to drive transformational AI adoption. You will collaborate closely with customer teams to ship advanced AI applications that solve real world business problems. Our FDEs engage with customers to accelerate the adoption of existing products and create new applications built on our models.

Working closely with our Post-Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll combine engineering expertise, an understanding of frontier AI applications, and customer-facing skills to understand customer workflows and develop innovative solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

You will sit at the frontier of enterprise AI deployments and serve as one of our founding FDEs who helps to shape our forward-deployed motion. We expect our FDEs to operate autonomously, thrive under ambiguity, and represent Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. This is a significant responsibility: you’ll play a key role in championing our mission in the enterprise.

Responsibilities

• Work within customer systems to build production applications with Claude models, ensuring that these products meet customer requirements.
• Deliver technical artifacts for customers like MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills that will be used in production workflows.
• Provide white glove deployment support for Anthropic products in enterprise environments.
• Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams.
• Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks.
• Build long term relationships with customers and proactively identify new opportunities for AI deployment throughout the lifecycle of an engagement.
• Travel frequently (25-50%) to customer sites to build in person with customers.
• Be a champion for Anthropic’s mission in the field.

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

• 8+ years of experience in a technical, customer facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, or as a Software Engineer with consulting experience. Former technical founders are also encouraged to apply.
• Native French speaker with fluent English proficiency
• Production experience with LLMs including advanced prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale.
• Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python (and ideally in one or more additional languages like TypeScript, Java, etc) and experience shipping production applications
• High agency with an ability to navigate ambiguity present in complex organizations.
• High cooperation mindset for cross-organizational collaboration, balancing competing priorities with integrity.
• Passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI systems through creative technical applications.
• Strong communication skills to conduct discovery with customers and to convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders while maintaining a low ego and collaborative approach.
• A background in financial services, healthcare/life sciences, or another enterprise vertical is a plus.
• Experience with enterprise IT systems and/or AI deployment patterns is a plus.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Are you a programmer with experience in game development who wants to take the next step by taking on cross-platform development? Do you enjoy tackling technical challenges, working across platforms, and figuring out what it takes to make gaming experiences run well on mobile devices? Then you might be the next addition to our herd!

About us

COFFEE STAIN NORTH is a small game developer based in Stockholm that belongs to the Coffee Stain Group. Since the company was founded in 2013, we have grown to 38 employees and are now open to adding a couple of new friends!

Goat Simulator 3 is a third-person sandbox adventure developed by Coffee Stain North in which the player can live out their wildest dreams... as a goat. Released in 2022, this comedy sandbox game takes the chaotic spirit of the original to new heights and offers expanded multiplayer support, a larger and more detailed environment, and even more absurd physics-driven gameplay.

Players can explore the island of San Angora solo or with friends, wreaking havoc as a goat (or one of many unlockable characters) through a wide range of quests, mini-games, and bizarre encounters.

Understanding games like Goat Simulator 3 means appreciating the fine line between "broken" and "brilliant." If that sounds like your kind of energy, come and get to know our herd!

The role

As an Intermediate Mobile Programmer at Coffee Stain North, you will work with game development in both Unreal Engine 4 and Unreal Engine 5, supporting both released and upcoming titles on iOS and Android.

You will collaborate closely with the wider Goat Simulator team, working together with artists, designers, and other programmers across different parts of the game. While you will contribute to the core experience alongside the rest of the team, your work will have a particular focus on the mobile-specific parts of development.

A key part of the role will be adapting and extending existing and future code to meet the requirements and pipelines needed for mobile game development and deployment. You will also help keep third-party SDKs and libraries within the codebase compatible and running smoothly.

Additionally, you will support the packaging and deployment of our games to mobile storefronts and contribute to solving the technical challenges that come with bringing our games to mobile platforms.

Your background

To succeed in this role, we believe that you have:

•

2+ years of professional experience in game development

•

Experience working with C++ in game development

•

Relevant experience in Unreal Engine

Experience in the following areas is considered a plus:

•

Mobile game development

•

CI/CD tools such as TeamCity, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions

•

Multiplayer games

•

Game optimization, both in terms of graphical fidelity and frame time

At Coffee Stain North, we have employees from different parts of the world, and it’s therefore mandatory to be fluent in English, both verbally and in writing.

Perks of working at Coffee Stain

We offer competitive salaries and excellent benefits that go beyond the usual payments to your pension fund and insurances.

•

We believe that a healthy body leads to a healthy mind, so on top of the wellness grant you get some paid time off to work out. Did we mention there are several gyms right beside our office?

•

Every fourth week it’s Creative Friday, which lets your inner passion blossom.

•

To have fun together and get inspired, we play games on the clock every fourth Friday.

•

We also have great parental benefits, including extra pay on top of what you get from the Social Insurance Agency during your parental leave.

•

And, of course, you will be part of a wonderful team of colleagues working on exciting projects.

Practical information

The position is permanent, full-time, 40 hours per week. We have a hybrid setup and offer the possibility of working from home two days per week.

Our office is newly renovated and located in Kungsholmen, Fridhemsplan. We have, among other things, a ping-pong table, a big lounge area where we hang out, watch movies, or play games together, and last but not least – a giant goat statue (what more do you need?).

Apart from us, the Coffee Stain Group consists of a myriad of successful studios, among them COFFEE STAIN STUDIOS (Sanctum and Satisfactory), Ghost Ship Games (Deep Rock Galactic), Tuxedo Labs (Teardown), and COFFEE STAIN PUBLISHING, who work with close partners like Iron Gate (Valheim), to name a few.

Your application

If you are interested, please apply! Due to GDPR, we can’t accept applications through email.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please reach out to Maria Sjöman, HR, at maria.sjoman@coffeestain.com.

jobs.description: As a Construction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's owner's representative throughout the full construction lifecycle. You play an integral role in delivering the built facilities and infrastructure that power Amazon's logistics network — including sortation centers, delivery stations, and auxiliary buildings — through new builds, retrofits, and expansions. In this role, you serve as the primary point of interface between Amazon and its external partners — developers, general contractors, design engineers, and authorities having jurisdiction (AHJ) — while collaborating closely with internal stakeholders responsible for equipping, furnishing, and operating our facilities. You are accountable for the safe, on-time, in scope, and on-budget delivery of construction projects, and you bring a disciplined approach to budget management, schedule oversight, contract execution, and quality assurance. You operate with a high degree of independence within your assigned region, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining clear and transparent communication with all project stakeholders. This role combines construction management, engineering, project planning, contract management, and facilities delivery — and requires approximately 60% regional travel within North America. This role requires 60% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided. Key job responsibilities Safety & Compliance - Champion Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams; hold all accountable to a safety-first culture - Interface and coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to maintain regulatory compliance and ensure seamless project execution - Lead or assist in negotiations with regulatory bodies as required for permitting and approvals Project & Construction Management - Manage multiple concurrent projects simultaneously — ranging from small renovations to large-scale ($100M+) new facility builds — from design phase through construction completion and operational handover - Serve as Amazon's owner's representative and primary integrator between construction execution teams and internal stakeholders (operations, equipment, IT, etc.) - Review construction documents, drawings, and specifications for conformance to Amazon's building standards and design guidelines - Identify and resolve design conflicts, schedule clashes, and coordination gaps with other Amazon execution teams - Conduct detailed reviews of contractor bid packages, budgets, and schedules to identify and resolve discrepancies - Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability Budget, Schedule & Contract Management - Own comprehensive budget tracking, cashflow forecasting, and cost management across assigned projects - Review, analyze, and respond to all proposed cost and time change requests submitted by external project teams - Negotiate construction, procurement, and labor contracts with developers and general contractors; present formal documentation for approval when required - Ensure contracts are fit for purpose, cost-effective, and incorporate appropriate service level agreements - Advise on the impact of changes in scope, schedule, cost, and permitting Contractor & Stakeholder Management - Audit contractor performance to ensure skills, competencies, and resources are appropriate for the work being performed - Ensure contracted resources deliver work that meets duration and quality targets; address and resolve underperformance issues - Coach and guide project teams — including developers, design engineers, general contractors, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders — throughout the full project lifecycle - Inform developers and contractors of projected changes in resource or work demand to enable proactive planning - Partner with teams responsible for base building management transition and oversight of all turnover documentation Communication & Reporting - Maintain clear, concise, and transparent communication with all internal and external stakeholders on project status, risks, and key developments - Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project data - Participate in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions - Prepare reports, specifications, and technical analyses to define design requirements, equipment needs, and services for expansion and remodel projects Innovation & Continuous Improvement - Provide critical review of current design standards to identify value engineering and design enhancement opportunities - Seek sustainable, environmentally responsible solutions throughout the construction process in alignment with Amazon's building practices - Identify and implement process improvements that drive better outcomes across safety, cost, schedule, and quality A day in the life Each day, you act as Amazon's owner on the ground — ensuring the safe, on-time, and on-budget execution of construction projects across your region. Your day may include: - Coordinating with general contractors on project status, upcoming milestones, and emerging risks - Reviewing and responding to RFIs, submittals, change order requests, and schedule updates - Participating in AOC meetings and driving accountability across the project team - Conducting site visits to verify construction quality and safety compliance - Updating Amazon's project management systems with current budget, schedule, and status information - Collaborating with internal stakeholders on facility readiness, equipment coordination, and operational handover planning - Reviewing design documents and providing feedback to engineering and design partner About the team At Amazon, the GES NA D&C team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.
